intent_anchor.user_goal: Deliver a charming playable 2.5D AIdle world where a text Companion and safe AI-directed prompt flow are visible to the player.
intent_anchor.current_priority: Replace the empty technical shell with a readable Starter Realm and expose the already-built safe interaction loop in the headed game.
allowed_scope: local headed Godot visual and input verification
text-only Companion, Desktop Bridge and safe prompt-flow UI integration
forbidden_scope: free-form 3D, voxel terrain or live Text-to-3D
live AI provider, credential or public network
direct UI or Companion durable mutation
new Grok top-level session, install, push, deploy or publish

claim_under_review: The G8 machine-passed build is ready for Human Product Lead alpha acceptance as a headed playable 2.5D Starter Realm.
what_i_accept: Godot headed debug build launches and remains responsive.
The fixed-angle camera, player locomotion and camera follow work.
The first-run art-direction selector is present.
Prior headless functional and authority gates remain valid.
what_i_challenge: The maximized playable view contains only a flat purple field, capsule player and orb Companion; no physical Starter Realm landmarks are visible.
The default window clips the art selector and Starter Realm text surface.
Companion chat, Desktop Bridge actions and prompt preview/confirm/cancel flow are not discoverable in the playable scene.
The presentation does not yet meet the requested Cozy Cyber-Pixel / Dreamy Low-Poly identity.
strongest_counter_argument: This build is a technically correct vertical-slice shell and the underlying systems are extensively tested. However, a shell with invisible interaction surfaces and no readable world cannot satisfy a headed alpha gate or the user's core experience goal.
missing_evidence: Headed screenshots showing a populated Starter Realm at two resolutions.
Visual proof of mounted Companion/Bridge UI and staged manifestation with confirm/cancel.
Clean headed log and regression evidence after visual integration.
scope_drift_risk: medium: visual correction must expose existing safe systems without inventing a parallel executor, direct mutation path or live-provider shortcut.
blind_spots: Automated window capture cannot judge long-session play feel or subjective charm as reliably as the Human Product Lead.
The adversarial-review skill's referenced schema directory is unavailable, so this object follows the documented contract without schema validation.
alternative_explanations: The underlying ground plane is present but visually merges with the environment because the selected palette lacks contrast and there are no landmarks.
next_action: Execute WO-G8-001-HEADED-CORRECTION-001 in the same Grok Desktop parent, then return WAITING_CODEX for headed and regression review.
